name: bookwaves
description: Cloud-based RFID circulation, tagging, and gate monitoring for libraries. BookWaves pairs a modern UI with pluggable RFID middleware and LMS connectors to deliver self-service checkout, returns, gate alarms, and tag management in one console.

paragraphs: Cloud-based RFID circulation, tagging, and gate monitoring for libraries. BookWaves pairs a modern UI with pluggable RFID middleware and LMS connectors to deliver self-service checkout, returns, gate alarms, and tag management in one console.
features: Self-checkout – Borrow, return, list items on the reader, and view patron accounts with LMS-backed status.
Security gate – Live monitoring with audio/visual alerts for secured items.
Reader console – Inspect items on a reader, secure/unsecure, edit media IDs, clear, or kill tags.
Tagging – Batch-initialize blank tags from barcodes.
Admin tooling – Inspect config and all middleware readers, and exercise LMS endpoints via a test console.

whatItDoes.text: Cloud-based RFID circulation, tagging, and gate monitoring for libraries. BookWaves pairs a modern UI with pluggable RFID middleware and LMS connectors to deliver self-service checkout, returns, gate alarms, and tag management in one console.

requirements.text: Alma requires a valid API key; mock LMS needs no credentials. login.mode controls the checkout dialogs and accepts usernamepassword (default), usernamepasswordorpin, usernameonly, scanneronly, or usernameorscanner.
